title: Cartridge artifact contracts
description: The compiled cartridge, its artifact file and the compiler and loader diagnostics (05 §8, §11, §12, §20; 08 §6; 14 §R4). R4 minimal: the frozen kinds only; rooms, NPCs, schedules, quests, dialogue, assets and localization join with their features, under a new format tag.

CompiledCartridge.description: The semantic payload a cartridge hash covers (05 §11 'Hash domains and attestations'): the manifest with its compatibility requirements, the exact capability lock (exactly requires.capabilities until a registry dependency exists; the loader rejects a difference with LOCK_MANIFEST_MISMATCH), and the normalized definitions of the frozen kinds, each map keyed by DefinitionRefString so canonical key order orders it. A key's cartridge_id and cartridge_version are the manifest's id and version and its last segment is the definition's key; the compiler guarantees this and the loader rejects a mismatch (ARTIFACT_DEFINITION_KEY_MISMATCH); the subset cannot express it. format is the hash domain tag and selects the variant. Compatibility (PM ruling, R5 S1 review A7/F3): adding an OPTIONAL field to an existing definition kind, or an optional new definition map, keeps the tag, because an artifact without it keeps its bytes, hash and meaning; a change in the meaning or requirement of an existing field (a field made required, removed or reinterpreted) takes a new tag. Loaders stay fail-closed: an older loader rejects a field it does not know as UNKNOWN_FIELD, and kernel_api ranges govern which loader a cartridge needs. No certificate, signature, package or catalog field belongs here (CAR-10). In R4 the authored cartridge.json is exactly the CartridgeManifest object form (kernel_api as {at_least, below}, capabilities as key to version); the string forms (">=1.3 <2.0", key@version) are not accepted yet.

facts.description: The cartridge's fact declarations, keyed by DefinitionRefString of kind fact.

policies.description: The cartridge's named policies, keyed by DefinitionRefString of kind policy.

actions.description: The cartridge's action definitions, keyed by DefinitionRefString of kind action.

oneOf.description: loka-cartridge-v1 (R4): the frozen kinds of R4 only.

facts.description: The cartridge's fact declarations, keyed by DefinitionRefString of kind fact.

policies.description: The cartridge's named policies, keyed by DefinitionRefString of kind policy.

actions.description: The cartridge's action definitions, keyed by DefinitionRefString of kind action.

rooms.description: The cartridge's rooms, keyed by DefinitionRefString of kind room (never empty: entry names one of them).

items.description: The cartridge's items, keyed by DefinitionRefString of kind item; absent when it has none (R5 S4, an optional map: the tag stays).

npcs.description: The cartridge's NPCs, keyed by DefinitionRefString of kind npc; absent when it has none (R5 S4, an optional map: the tag stays).

recipes.description: The cartridge's action recipes (action.schema.json ActionRecipe), keyed by DefinitionRefString of kind recipe; absent when it has none (R5 S5, an optional map: the tag stays).

resources.description: The cartridge's resources (resource.schema.json ResourceSpec), keyed by DefinitionRefString of kind resource; absent when it has none (R5 S6b, an optional map: the tag stays). The compiler adds the default pools hp, ma and mv, resource@1 and schedule@1 (wait, so an exhausted body can regenerate) to every v2 cartridge; an artifact without them (older or hand-built) has no pools, and its moves cost nothing.

attributes.description: The cartridge's attributes (AttributeSpec), keyed by DefinitionRefString of kind attribute; absent when it has none (C1 c1-attributes, an optional map: the tag stays). Its kind and the policy leaves stat_compare and resource_compare need attributes@1 in the lock.

entry.description: The room a new run's player starts in (00a §12 manifest entry); a room of this cartridge.

barriers.description: The cartridge's barriers, keyed by DefinitionRefString of kind barrier; absent when it has none (R5 S7, an optional map: the tag stays).

quests.description: The cartridge's quests, keyed by DefinitionRefString of kind quest; absent when it has none (Early R7/R8 Q, an optional map: the tag stays).

dialogues.description: The cartridge's dialogues, keyed by DefinitionRefString of kind dialogue; absent when it has none (Early R7/R8 D1, an optional map: the tag stays).

story_points.description: The cartridge's story points (23 §3), keyed by DefinitionRefString of kind story_point; absent when it has none (Early R7/R8 D2, an optional map: the tag stays).

reactions.description: The cartridge's reaction rules, keyed by DefinitionRefString of kind reaction; absent when it has none (Early R7/R8 R, an optional map: the tag stays).

oneOf.description: loka-cartridge-v2 (R5 slice 1): v1 plus rooms, the entry room and the default-locale text catalog. The compiler emits v2 exactly when the source has rooms, an entry or a text catalog, so a cartridge without rooms keeps its v1 bytes and hash.

CartridgeArtifact.description: The compiled artifact file: one canonical JSON document, built and never committed (05 §20). content_hash is the cartridge hash (CartridgeRelease.cartridge_hash): SHA-256 of the canonical bytes (loka-numeric-v1) of cartridge. It hashes cartridge only, never itself, so it can sit beside it (CAR-10); the loader recomputes it and rejects a mismatch.

StoryPointDefinition.description: A story point the cartridge declares (23 §3; 03 §26; Early R7/R8 D2), keyed in CompiledCartridge.story_points by DefinitionRefString of kind story_point, its event story_point_reached owned by dialogue@1: its key, the report's story point (account.schema.json StoryPointReport), and outcomes, at least one (a loader check: the subset has no minProperties), each reached by its rule-owned trigger: the choice of a dialogue (choose emits story_point_reached after choice_resolved in that decision's root sequence). A trigger site feeds one outcome of one story point (DUPLICATE_DEFINITION), and its dialogue resolves a quest (OUTCOME_MISMATCH otherwise), so a choice reaches it once. In source it is story_points/<key>.json, its dialogue a short reference.

AttributeSpec.description: attributes@1 (00 §4.3 and 06 §21 amendments 2026-10-03): an attribute and its starting value, content and never an engine default. Every actor's value is start while nothing writes attributes (no state). In source, attributes.json's {"attributes": {key: {start}}}, the key taken from the map (an authored key is UNKNOWN_FIELD).

Calendar.description: calendar@1 (21 §4 Time; capability_registry.json definitions): start, the logical time a fresh world begins at, on day 1 (command.schema.json LogicalTime units; 21600 is 06:00), so its first jobs' due times stay safe integers. Absent, a world begins at 0. An optional map of loka-cartridge-v2 (Early R7/R8 S): the tag stays. In source it is cartridge.json's calendar, beside entry.

ArtifactSize.description: The byte length of a cartridge artifact file, checked before decoding: at most 4 MiB (owner decision, docs/archive/decisions/owner-decisions-r4-2026-09-25.md, item 2). bin/contracts.exs emits the maximum into kernel/ts/src/contracts.gen.ts as ARTIFACT_MAX_BYTES; Elixir reads it here.

DiagnosticCode.description: A diagnostic code: a closed set, one code per distinct cause (08 §6: repair loops read codes and data, never prose). INVALID_JSON: a source file is not JSON (RFC 8259, UTF-8); in the loader, the artifact is not UTF-8 or fails the canonical decoder (loka-numeric-v1), duplicate keys included, path empty, data {}; DUPLICATE_KEY: an object in a source file repeats a key (Elixir's JSON keeps the first silently, so the compiler checks it); UNKNOWN_FIELD: a field outside the registered schema (05 §5); the validator's unknown_property; in the loader, path the validator's, data {}; SCHEMA_VIOLATION: any other schema error; a dialogue without a choice is too_few_items at its choices, and a story point without an outcome at its outcomes (the subset has no minProperties; in the loader at the reference stage); data.error is its ErrorCode (error_registry.json); a v2 source (rooms, an entry or text.json) without an entry is missing_property at cartridge.entry; in the loader, path the validator's; MISSING_MANIFEST: the cartridge has no cartridge.json (05 §3); path is cartridge; DUPLICATE_DEFINITION: two definitions in one cartridge have one DefinitionRef (03 §2, 05 §4; other cartridges' refs differ, CAR-01), or a recipe's key is an action's of the cartridge or a registered command type (an engine verb's), one ActionSet identity with two definitions (06 §19), path the recipe (recipes/ring_bell; in the loader .cartridge.recipes["..."], at the reference stage), data {}; or a dialogue's key is a registered command type's, an action's, a recipe's or a quest's (its talk is one ActionSet identity), path the dialogue (dialogues/bram; in the loader .cartridge.dialogues["..."], at the reference stage), data {}; or a dialogue role is named actor (the actor is always a participant), path the role (dialogues/bram.roles.actor), data {}; or two story point outcomes name one trigger site (a dialogue and its choice, which would reach both), path each outcome (story_points/lantern_resolved.outcomes.carry; in the loader .cartridge.story_points["..."].outcomes.carry, at the reference stage), data {}; or two recipes' checks have one key, one check DefinitionRef with two definitions (action.schema.json RecipeCheck), path each such recipe's check (recipes/pick_lock.check; in the loader .cartridge.recipes["..."].check, at the reference stage), data {}; FACT_NAME_COLLISION: two authored fact names map to one key after each . becomes _ (owner decision, IMPORT.md); FACT_DEFAULT_INVALID: a fact default is outside its enum values or int bounds (fact.schema.json FactType); UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE: a reference names no definition (CAR-02, A10); an exit's to or the entry names no room of this cartridge (05 §17), or, in v2, a room's title or description, a detail's description (path rooms/well_lane.details.bucket.description) or a description variant's (rooms/well_lane.variants[0].description) or an action's label or accessibility, or an item's or NPC's short, room_line, room-line variant or description has no text catalog entry; an item's location or an NPC's room names no definition of that kind in this cartridge; an exit's barrier names no barrier of this cartridge (path rooms/cell.exits.east.barrier), or an item's barrier none (path items/trunk.barrier; in the loader .cartridge.items["..."].barrier, data {target}), or a barrier's key_item no item of it (barriers/cell_door.key_item), or a barrier's short has no text catalog entry; a recipe's target room names no room of this cartridge, or its detail no detail of that room (data {target} the detail key), a recipe's fact.assign fact no fact of it, or its label or narration has no text catalog entry; a reaction's trigger fact or room, or a fact.assign fact of its apply, names no fact or room of this cartridge (path reactions/gossip.on.fact; in the loader .cartridge.reactions["..."].on.fact, .apply[0].fact); a dialogue's npc or quest, a role's npc or item, or a fact.assign fact or the accept of a choice names no definition of that kind in this cartridge, its npc is none of its npc roles (path dialogues/bram.npc, data {target} the npc), or a choice's hand_over item names no item role or its to no npc role (path dialogues/bram.choices.leave.hand_over.to, data {target} the role name; in the loader .cartridge.dialogues["..."].choices.leave.hand_over.to), or a dialogue's prompt or a choice's label or narration has no text catalog entry (path dialogues/bram.choices.carry.narration); a quest's title or offer label has no text catalog entry (path quests/lantern.offer.label), or its objective's item_acquired names no item of this cartridge (path quests/lantern.objective.item_acquired); a story point outcome's dialogue names no dialogue of this cartridge (path story_points/lantern_resolved.outcomes.carry.dialogue), or its choice none of that dialogue's choices (path ...outcomes.carry.choice, data {target} the choice); a key of a room's action contribution names no registered command, action or recipe of this cartridge (data {target} the key, path rooms/belfry.actions[0].actions[1]); a stat_compare's attribute or a resource_compare's resource names no attribute or resource of this cartridge (path the member, recipes/pray.policy.root.attribute; in the loader .cartridge.recipes["..."].policy.root.resource, data {target}); or a touch link in the catalog string of a room's, detail's, variant's, item's or NPC's text names no target (the loader too since R5 S8, path the text key's member, .cartridge.rooms["..."].description): a link's target is the detail, item or NPC it names, a link without a target key in a detail's, item's or NPC's own text is that thing itself, and a target key names a detail of the room (in a room's or its details' text), an item or an NPC of the cartridge, so a link without one in a room's own text has none (data target is then the link as written), data {target} (the DefinitionRefString or the TextKey), path the reference (rooms/ferry_landing.exits.north.to, cartridge.entry, rooms/ferry_landing.title, actions/talk.label; in the loader .cartridge.rooms["..."].exits.north.to, .cartridge.entry); CONTAINMENT_CYCLE: an item's location leads, through the items it starts in, back to itself (invariant containment_acyclic), path its location's item member (items/satchel.location.item; in the loader .cartridge.items["..."].location.item), data {}; CAPACITY_EXCEEDED: more items start in an item or NPC than its capacity (invariant containment_acyclic), path its capacity (items/satchel.capacity), data {capacity, held}; TOUCH_LINK_MISSING (compiler only, severity warning, the build succeeds): a room's description or one of its description variants has no touch link to one of the room's details, or an item's or NPC's room line or one of its room-line variants has none to that item or NPC (owner decision 2026-09-25, Q3; text.schema.json TextCatalog), path the text key's member (rooms/ferry_landing.variants[0].description, items/lantern.room_line), data {target} (the detail, item or NPC key); UNREACHABLE_DETAIL: a room's detail's first alias, which names it when a lookup is ambiguous, is also an alias of another detail of that room, or has an empty word or starts with at, the, a or an, so no lookup picks it by that name (room.schema.json InspectableDetail), path the detail (rooms/ferry_landing.details.lamp_post; in the loader .cartridge.rooms["..."].details.lamp_post), data {}; UNKNOWN_COMMAND: an action's command is not in the command registry (action.schema.json ActionDefinition), or is run_job, which is authority-internal and never built from an invocation (04 §1); in the loader, no capability owns it (capability_registry.json) or it is run_job, path .cartridge.actions["..."].command, data {}; FACT_TYPE_MISMATCH: a fact_compare value, a recipe's fact.assign value in any outcome, or a reaction's or dialogue choice's fact.assign value, is not of the fact's type (06 §21: typed policy AST; the loader checks it too, at the reference stage, R5 S6a), path the value (recipes/ring_bell.outcomes.success.sequence[0].value; in the loader .cartridge.recipes["..."].outcomes.failure.sequence[0].value); UNKNOWN_CAPABILITY: a key in requires.capabilities is not registered at that version (A10, Gate R4); SERVER_ONLY_CAPABILITY: an offline_private cartridge requires a server_only capability (05 §6, C4); KERNEL_API_RANGE_INVALID: the kernel_api range is empty or reversed, at_least not below below (05 §3; a malformed version string is SCHEMA_VIOLATION); PINNED_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED: content_schema or rule_ir is a version the compiler or installed kernel does not implement (05 §3; both implement 1 now), data {field, declared, supported}; in the loader, path .cartridge.manifest.requires.<field>; UNDECLARED_CAPABILITY: a definition uses a command, event or policy op (a recipe step uses the event it produces: fact.assign fact_changed, event.emit custom_event; a reaction uses its trigger's event, on.event, and each fact.assign's fact_changed, path its op; a story point uses story_point_reached, path the story point), or is of a definition kind (a room, a room's detail, a room's or detail's description variant, a recipe, a barrier, a reaction, a dialogue, an attribute), whose owning capability (capability_registry.json) the manifest does not require (05 §6), path the room or barrier file for a room or barrier (.cartridge.rooms["..."], .cartridge.barriers["..."] in the loader), attributes.<key> for an attribute (.cartridge.attributes["..."] in the loader), rooms/<key>.details.<detail> for a detail, rooms/<key>.variants[i] or rooms/<key>.details.<detail>.variants[i] for a variant, data {capability} (the owner's key), suggested_capabilities [its key@version]; in the loader, the lock lacks the owner's key, path the command or op member (.cartridge.actions["..."].command, ...policy.root.items[0].op); NESTING_TOO_DEEP: the compiled artifact would nest a definition deeper than the canonical depth limit (loka-numeric-v1), data {maximum}; the author's file is valid JSON, so this is not INVALID_JSON, while the loader reports a too-deep artifact as INVALID_JSON; ARTIFACT_TOO_LARGE: the artifact file exceeds ArtifactSize, checked before decoding, path empty, data {bytes, maximum}; UNKNOWN_FORMAT: the artifact's cartridge.format is absent or neither loka-cartridge-v1 nor loka-cartridge-v2, path .cartridge.format, data {}; CONTENT_HASH_MISMATCH: content_hash differs from the hash of cartridge (05 §11, CAR-05), path .content_hash, data {declared, computed}; ARTIFACT_DEFINITION_KEY_MISMATCH: a definition map key's cartridge_id or cartridge_version differs from the manifest's id or version, or its key from the definition's key (a policy has no key field, so only the first two apply; a kind other than its map's fails the propertyNames pattern, SCHEMA_VIOLATION); the schema cannot express this check; path the map member (.cartridge.facts["..."]), one diagnostic per differing field, data {field, declared, expected} with field cartridge_id, cartridge_version or key; LOCK_MANIFEST_MISMATCH: lock.capabilities differs from manifest.requires.capabilities for a key, which in R4 must be equal (path .cartridge.lock.capabilities.<key> even when the lock lacks it, data {capability, required, locked}, the absent side omitted); a registry-dependency closure will change this rule under a new format tag; CAPABILITY_NOT_INSTALLED: the lock names a key@version the installed kernel lacks (05 §6), path .cartridge.lock.capabilities.<key>, data {capability: key@version}; KERNEL_API_UNSUPPORTED: the installed kernel_api is outside the manifest's range (05 §3), path .cartridge.manifest.requires.kernel_api, data {installed}; FACT_SCOPE_UNSUPPORTED: loader only; the installed kernel cannot read a fact of these scopes: the TypeScript kernel hosts one private world, which has a player (the actor's CharacterId) and an instance (its WorldContextId) but no party or realm, and fact_compare names no scope, so it reads a fact at the one scope the fact allows; a fact whose scopes are not exactly one of player or instance fails, path .cartridge.facts["..."].scopes, data {}; CLIENT_FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED: the installed app lacks a required client feature (CAR-07), path .cartridge.manifest.requires.client_features[i], data {feature}. EMPTY_TIME_WINDOW: a time_window policy node's from equals its to, a window that never holds (policy.schema.json), path the node (actions/ring.policy.root; in the loader .cartridge.recipes["..."].policy.root), data {}, at the reference stage in the loader; OUTCOME_MISMATCH: a recipe with a check has no failure outcome, or one without a check has one (action.schema.json ActionRecipe), path the recipe's outcomes (recipes/pry_lid.outcomes), data {}, at the reference stage in the loader; or a story point outcome's dialogue resolves no quest, so its choice could reach it again (StoryPointDefinition), path the outcome (story_points/lantern_resolved.outcomes.carry), data {}, at the reference stage in the loader; or a dialogue choice's accept is in a dialogue that resolves a quest (accepting would resolve it), path the accept (dialogues/bram_offer.choices.accept.accept), or on a choice with a hand_over (activation and acquisition in one decision conflict), path the hand_over (dialogues/bram_offer.choices.accept.hand_over), data {}, at the reference stage in the loader; RESOURCE_SPEC_INVALID: a resource's bounds are reversed or its start is outside them (resource.schema.json ResourceSpec), path the resource (resources.resources.hp; in the loader .cartridge.resources["..."]), data {}, at the reference stage in the loader; or a condition band table (resource.schema.json BandTable) has cuts not strictly descending, a last cut other than 0 or a repeated key, path the table (resources.resources.mv.bands, cartridge.world.bands; in the loader .cartridge.resources["..."].bands, .cartridge.world.bands), data {}, at the reference stage in the loader. BARRIER_MISMATCH: an exit with a barrier and its reciprocal face (its destination's exit in the opposite compass direction, when that leads back to its room; a connection's identity is its room and direction) do not name the same barrier, or the reciprocal face is missing (21 §5 Barrier: both faces reference one state; 05 §25 coherent connections; one-sided barriers are not yet declarable), path the exit (rooms/cell.exits.east; in the loader .cartridge.rooms["..."].exits.east), each face that has a barrier or faces one reported, data {}, at the reference stage in the loader; or an item's barrier is also named by an exit or another item (21 §5 as amended by c1-locks: an item's barrier has one site), path each such item's barrier (items/trunk.barrier; in the loader .cartridge.items["..."].barrier), data {}. BARRIER_UNREACHABLE_KEY: a locked barrier on an exit of a room reachable from the entry, or on an item in reach (a container's lid, c1-locks), has a key that never comes within reach, or no key_item (05 §17 reachability): rooms are reached from the entry through exits without a barrier or whose barrier starts open, closed, or locked with a key already in reach, and an item is in reach when it starts in a reached room or inside an item in reach whose barrier is absent, not locked, or locked with its key in reach (initial states and locations only: no recipes, facts or NPCs; so a key inside its own locked chest, or two chests holding each other's keys, is reported); a key_item that names no item is UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE instead; path the barrier (barriers/cell_door; in the loader .cartridge.barriers["..."]), data {}, at the reference stage in the loader. RESERVED_FACT: under position@1 the engine owns the fact position (the compiler adds it, cartridge.md Compiler; only rules/position.ts writes it): in the compiler, an authored fact named position, path facts.facts.position, or a fact.assign of it in a recipe outcome, a reaction's apply or a dialogue choice, path the step's fact (recipes/nap.outcomes.success.sequence[0].fact, reactions/gossip.apply[0].fact, dialogues/bram.choices.leave.sequence[0].fact); in the loader the same writes (.cartridge.recipes["..."].outcomes.success.sequence[0].fact), and the position FactSpec missing or not exactly the engine's, path .cartridge.facts["<id>@<version>:fact/position"]; data {}, at the reference stage in the loader; reading it (fact_compare, a reaction's on.fact) is allowed, and without position@1 a fact named position is the cartridge's own. A recipe's cost, threshold check or resource.adjust step whose resource names no resource of the cartridge is UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE at that resource member (recipes/pick_lock.costs[0].resource), data {target}; so is world.movement.cost's resource (cartridge.world.movement.cost.resource; in the loader .cartridge.world.movement.cost.resource), and an authored band key without a band.<key> catalog entry is UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE at the key (resources.resources.mv.bands[0].key, cartridge.world.bands[0].key), data {target} the text key. In the loader, suggested_capabilities is empty except for UNDECLARED_CAPABILITY. The loader checks an artifact in this order and stops at the first stage that fails, before any save mutation (CAR-07), reporting the first of that stage's diagnostics in list order (Diagnostic): ArtifactSize (ARTIFACT_TOO_LARGE); canonical decode (INVALID_JSON); cartridge.format (UNKNOWN_FORMAT); CartridgeArtifact (UNKNOWN_FIELD, SCHEMA_VIOLATION); content_hash (CONTENT_HASH_MISMATCH); definition keys (ARTIFACT_DEFINITION_KEY_MISMATCH); lock against requirements (LOCK_MANIFEST_MISMATCH; UNKNOWN_COMMAND and UNDECLARED_CAPABILITY re-run against the lock: every command an action uses has an owning capability, and every command and policy op a definition uses has its owning capability's key in the lock, CAR-07; and every room's, detail's, item's, NPC's, barrier's, variant's and reaction's owning capability too, and the ops of every variant's and reaction's condition, each reaction's trigger event, each fact.assign's fact_changed and each story point's story_point_reached; events join when a frozen kind references one); references (UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE: in any format each fact_compare's fact, each has_item's item, each barrier_state's barrier and each quest_state's quest names a fact, item, barrier or quest of this cartridge (path its fact, item, barrier or quest member, data {target}); FACT_TYPE_MISMATCH; EMPTY_TIME_WINDOW; OUTCOME_MISMATCH; DUPLICATE_DEFINITION for recipes, dialogues and story point triggers; SCHEMA_VIOLATION for a dialogue without a choice or a story point without an outcome; RESOURCE_SPEC_INVALID; v2 only: exits and their barriers, entry, text keys, item, NPC and barrier text keys, touch links, items' locations, barriers' key items, recipes' targets, facts, resources and text keys, reactions' triggers and facts, and rooms' action contribution keys; UNREACHABLE_DETAIL; CONTAINMENT_CYCLE; CAPACITY_EXCEEDED; BARRIER_MISMATCH; BARRIER_UNREACHABLE_KEY; RESERVED_FACT); the installed kernel and app (CAPABILITY_NOT_INSTALLED, FACT_SCOPE_UNSUPPORTED, KERNEL_API_UNSUPPORTED, PINNED_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED, CLIENT_FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED). The loader re-checks the content_schema and rule_ir pins: the artifact crosses a trust boundary.

Diagnostic.description: A structured diagnostic (08 §6; 05 §8: every compile stage emits them). severity is error, which fails the build, except for a warning (TOUCH_LINK_MISSING), which the compiler reports beside the artifact. message_key is diagnostics. followed by the code in lowercase; data carries the code's facts as strings and integers; suggested_capabilities lists capability pins that would fix it (the key@version form requires uses), possibly none. A list of diagnostics is in one deterministic order (05 §8, CAR-04): by path, then code, comparing UTF-8 bytes, then by the canonical encoding of the whole diagnostic; an identical diagnostic appears once.

path.description: Where a diagnostic applies (08 §6). A compiler path is a source followed by steps; a loader path is steps only, relative to the artifact file, and empty for the whole file, so it is empty or starts with . or [. The source is the file's path relative to the cartridge root, / separated, without its .json extension (quests/missing_child, cartridge for cartridge.json); if a segment is not [a-z0-9_]+ or the file does not end in .json, the source is instead the whole relative path as a canonical JSON string literal (loka-numeric-v1). Steps: .name for an object member whose name is [a-z0-9_]+; ["..."] with the name as a canonical JSON string literal for any other member; [n] for array index n (decimal, no leading zeros). Example: quests/missing_child.objectives[2].target; a diagnostic about a whole file is its source alone.

WorldSettings.description: The cartridge's world settings (owner decision world parameters; 00 §4 and 04 §15 as amended 2026-10-02), each optional with an engine default: movement.cost, what a move costs the body (movement@1; default 1 mv when the cartridge declares mv), its resource a pool of this cartridge (UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE otherwise); bands, the condition band table of every pool without its own (resource.schema.json BandTable; default the 04 §15 table). An optional field of loka-cartridge-v2: the tag stays, and the compiler writes it only when the source authors it. In source it is cartridge.json's world, beside entry.
